def blocks2(i):
    S=set()
    for r in range(len(i)):
        s=set(i[r])
        if len(s)==1 and next(iter(s))!=0: S.add(next(iter(s)))
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])
    seps=[c for c in range(W) if i[0][c] in S]
    b=[];cols=[]
    if not seps: return None,None
    cols=[0]+seps+[W]
    rows=[];rs=[0];rs+=sorted(set(r for r in range(H) if i[r] in S));rs.append(H)
    return rs,cols
